items.sentence: One huge pumpkin sat proudly in the autumn field.
A pile of yellow leaves grew next to the path.
Today, sunflowers react to sunlight by turning their bright heads.
Today, deep sea creatures exist far below the ocean waves.
Today, the cows rested in the shade of the tree.
Today, water is an important element of every healthy garden.
One thin layer of snow covered the sleeping garden.
Students record the Sun rising above the eastern horizon.
Students observe plant growth after changing only the light.
Tall trees block the strong wind close to the house.
